youtube.title: Do You Need an AI Receptionist? Fix Quote Follow-Up First (Cleaning Business)
youtube.description:
Do you need an AI receptionist? Fix follow-up on the quotes you sent first.
For cleaning business owners and home service business owners.
PHCP Pros, "ServiceTitan Report Finds AI Adoption Accelerating Across the Trades" (Sep 29, 2026), on ServiceTitan's 2026 State of AI in the Trades report, a study of over 1,000 residential service contractors across the US in HVAC, electrical, plumbing, roofing and other sectors: only 11% of contractors place high or complete trust in the AI tools they use, while 58% report little or no trust.

Steps (the prompt is an example):
1. Paste a quote you already sent into an AI chat app.
2. Ask: "Write a short check-in on this quote, in my voice. Ask what questions they have."
3. Read the draft and hit send yourself. Nothing goes out without you.

Send this to whoever handles your follow-ups.
Next lesson: turning walkthrough notes into a quote. More lessons and free tools for trade owners at proofnotfluff.com
